segments.name: Hardware Solutions
segments.description: Manufactures engineered window and door hardware, screens, and other fenestration components for residential and light-commercial building markets.
segments.evidence: Our Hardware Solutions segment manufactures engineered window and door hardware, screens, and other fenestration components primarily serving the residential and light-commercial building markets.

segments.name: Extruded Solutions
segments.description: Supplies insulating glass spacers, vinyl and composite profiles, and sealing solutions for windows, doors, conservatories, and roofs across North America and Europe.
segments.evidence: Our Extruded Solutions segment manufactures insulating-glass spacers, vinyl and composite profiles, and sealing solutions used in the fabrication of windows, doors, conservatories, roofs, and related building applications.

segments.name: Custom Solutions
segments.description: Delivers engineered wood, metal, and elastomeric product solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial end markets.
segments.evidence: Our Custom Solutions segment delivers a diverse range of engineered product solutions across wood, metal, and elastomeric materials that serve residential, commercial, and industrial end markets.

revenueModel.text: Quanex sells custom-engineered components manufactured to customer specifications to national and regional OEMs, distributors, and contractors, largely in North America and the U.K.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently manufacture and distribute components for original equipment manufacturers (OEM) in the building products industry, including window, door, solar, refrigeration, custom mixing, building access, and cabinetry markets.

changes.text: In 2024, Quanex completed the acquisition of Tyman plc, adding complementary building products businesses.
changes.evidence: Most recently, on August 1, 2024, we completed our acquisition of Tyman plc, a company incorporated in England and Wales ("Tyman").

changes.text: In 2025, Quanex restructured into three reportable segments: Hardware Solutions, Extruded Solutions, and Custom Solutions.
changes.evidence: As a result, we now report three reportable segments: Hardware Solutions, which provides window and door hardware and screens; Extruded Solutions, which supplies insulating glass spacers, vinyl window and door profiles, seals, and weatherstripping; and Custom Solutions, which provides wood, mixing, and building access solutions.
